description: STEP 3 of the comprehension pipeline: the WORLD-KNOWLEDGE / BRIDGING codebook the gap-driven inference generator (domains/inference_generation.py) decodes gaps against. situation_model_reader (step 2) builds a situation model but only from STATED information -- a bare 'John dropped the glass.' infers on_floor but not broken, because the broken-rule (seeds/event_reasoning.json infer_broken) needs `fragile`, and fragility is WORLD KNOWLEDGE the text never states. This seed supplies that missing knowledge as a small, honest, FINITE codebook of ShapeSignature{kind:'knowledge_*'} schemas the decode (reflective_faculty.compose_design_for_goal = the ShapeDecode Term) matches gaps against -- the SAME collapse mechanism reading_collapse's construction codebook uses, at the knowledge grain instead of the syntax grain. Two flavors, one mechanism: 'knowledge_enabling' schemas supply an ENABLING-CONDITION property (glass/cup/vase/bottle -> fragile) that completes a stalled rule precondition; 'knowledge_elaborative' schemas supply a non-blocking elaboration (glass -> made_of_glass) that only fires under a DEEP standard_of_coherence; 'knowledge_partwhole' schemas supply a BRIDGING part_of link (beer/food/sandwiches/napkins/blanket -> supplies) for a definite NP with no discourse antecedent -- Haviland & Clark given-new bridging, no lexical cue required. The StandardOfCoherence node is the single tunable gate (McKoon & Ratcliff minimalist 'shallow' vs Graesser constructionist 'deep') that decides whether elaborative schemas are allowed to fire; enabling and bridging schemas are tagged 'blocking' and always fire (both frameworks agree a coherence-blocking / felicity-requiring inference is drawn). HONEST SCOPE: this codebook covers exactly the entities/attrs listed below -- an entity the codebook does not name (e.g. a bare 'ball') produces NO covering part, so the decode's own residual stays non-empty and nothing is minted (the discriminative, non-fabricating case). The KNOWLEDGE is finite and seeded; the MECHANISM (gap-detect -> ShapeDecode -> mint -> re-run the fixpoint) is general.

attrs.name: inference_knowledge
attrs.description: The sentinel concept guarding idempotent load of this seed (domains/inference_generation.py ensure_seeds).

The IMPERATIVE-WARNING lexicon the goal-level licensing gate reads (domains/inference_generation.detect_warning_gaps). A verb-INITIAL clause whose head is one of these caution/avoid-danger imperatives ('Beware the Jabberwock', 'shun the Bandersnatch') is a DIRECTIVE to an addressee, not a state predication about a protagonist -- it installs NO need-state, so it can never LICENSE a goal on its own (the DETACHED reader's verdict: held open). `licensed_response` names the QUEST a BELIEVED danger-warning warrants WITHIN a believer's belief-world (a named monster one is warned of -> the response the warning implies is to slay it) -- read only on the STANCE-RELATIVE / embedded path (resolve_warning_embedded), never on the detached path. Deliberately NOT a MarkerClass: it never enters reading_collapse's reading skeleton (an imperative verb in a clause's main-verb slot would collide with ordinary clause decoding, exactly the collision character_tom's ATTITUDE class avoids), only this module's warning scan reads it. An unseen caution verb JOINS by WordNet path-similarity to `anchor` >= `threshold` (the SAME nearness signal COS/ATTITUDE use), so it is graph-native codebook data, never a hardcoded story rule.

The STANCE-RELATIVE TRUST codebook the embedded-reading licensing gate reads (domains/inference_generation.trust_membership). A warning is LICENSED WITHIN a belief-world iff that world TRUSTS the warning's SOURCE. The addressee-vocative of a warning ('Beware the Jabberwock, my SON!') fixes the source-addressee relation: a KIN vocative (`trusted_anchor`: son/child/daughter/...) means the addresser is family -> the addressee TRUSTS the source -> WITHIN the addressee's belief-world the warning licenses 'the named threat is dangerous' and the quest to slay it. An ADVERSARIAL vocative (`untrusted_anchor`: stranger/enemy/foe/...) means the source is NOT trusted -> the warning licenses NOTHING even embedded. HONEST COVERAGE: the held nearness signal (reading_collapse._wordnet_nearness) is VERB-only (pos='v'); trust vocatives are NOUNS, so this lexicon resolves by SEED MEMBERSHIP (the listed anchors), NOT WordNet generalization -- a vocative outside these lists is `unknown` -> conservatively NOT trusted (no license), the discriminative non-fabricating null. This trust is a GRAPH SIGNAL over the vocative + the codebook, never a hardcoded 'jabberwock'/'father' story rule.
